Go SDK v2

A typed client for the v2 REST API, for Go 1.18+.

Install

terminal bash 
go get github.com/godzilla-io/sdk-go

Create a client

main.go go 
package main

import (
	"os"
	"github.com/godzilla-io/sdk-go"
)

func main() {
	client := godzilla.NewClient(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY"))
}

Create a pipeline

Maps directly onto the Pipelines endpoint — see the Building your first pipeline guide for the concepts.

create_pipeline.go go 
pipeline, err := client.Pipelines.Create(ctx, &godzilla.CreatePipelineRequest{
	Name:                    "ingest-orders",
	SourceConnectorID:       "conn_pg_orders",
	DestinationConnectorID:  "conn_snowflake_dw",
})
if err != nil {
	panic(err)
}

Handling failed events

Wraps the replay action described in Handling errors & retries:

replay.go go 
err := client.Events.Replay(ctx, "evt_8f2c1a90")
if err != nil {
	panic(err)
}
Context support

All client methods accept a context.Context parameter for timeout, cancellation, and request tracing.

Node.js SDK v2

A thin, typed wrapper around the v2 REST API for Node.js and TypeScript projects.

Install

terminal bash 
npm install @godzilla/sdk

Create a client

client.ts typescript 
import { Godzilla } from "@godzilla/sdk";

const godzilla = new Godzilla({ apiKey: process.env.GODZILLA_API_KEY });

Create a pipeline

Maps directly onto the Pipelines endpoint — see the Building your first pipeline guide for the concepts.

create-pipeline.ts typescript 
const pipeline = await godzilla.pipelines.create({
  name: "ingest-orders",
  sourceConnectorId: "conn_pg_orders",
  destinationConnectorId: "conn_snowflake_dw",
});

Listening for webhooks

The SDK includes a signature-verification helper for webhook payloads:

verify.ts typescript 
import { verifyWebhookSignature } from "@godzilla/sdk";

const isValid = verifyWebhookSignature(rawBody, signatureHeader, webhookSecret);
Retries are built in

The SDK retries idempotent requests (GET, and POST with an Idempotency-Key) automatically on 429 and 5xx responses using the same backoff the API itself uses.
